Resolves #20101

Authored by @neo-gemini-julia
Evidence: level=unit, command="npx playwright test --config=test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec.mjs"

## Summary

Implements the two-tier Sitemap Index (`sitemap.xml` -> `sitemap-core.xml` + `sitemap-archive.xml`) and three-tier `llmstxt.org` context hierarchy (`llms.txt` + `llms-full.txt` + `llms-all.txt`) for the Neo.mjs Portal:

- [`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d8f68f311d/buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs):
  - Adds `onlyArchives = false` to `collectAllRoutes` and `getSitemapXml` so `sitemap-archive.xml` emits exclusively the `19,436` ticket, PR, and discussion archive `<url>` entries while `sitemap-core.xml` (`includeArchives: false`) emits the `469` canonical core routes under `<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">`.
  - Exports `getLatestSitemapLastmod` and `getSitemapIndexXml` to emit a `<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` referencing `sitemap-core.xml` and `sitemap-archive.xml` with their newest `<lastmod>` dates.
  - Appends a standard `llmstxt.org` `## Optional` section to the curated `llms.txt` (`includeArchives: false`) linking to `llms-full.txt` and `llms-all.txt`.
  - Exports `getLlmsFullTxt` to walk `learn/tree.json` (`143` nodes, `19` parent folders) and concatenate the full Markdown prose of all `124` leaf guides (`1.67 MB` / `~427k` tokens) with `# [Title](rawUrl)` and `Source: canonicalUrl` headers.
- [`buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d8f68f311d/buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs):
  - Generates and writes `sitemap-core.xml`, `sitemap-archive.xml`, `sitemap.xml` (index), `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `llms-all.txt` into `apps/portal/`.
- [`buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d8f68f311d/buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs):
  - Expands `SEO_FILES` to copy all 7 SEO/LLM files (`robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `llms-all.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `sitemap-core.xml`, `sitemap-archive.xml`) into `dist/{development,esm,production}/apps/portal/`.

## Post-Merge Validation

- **Deploy Order:** [`neomjs/middleware-v2#40`](https://github.com/neomjs/middleware-v2/pull/40) (merged to `main`) MUST be deployed before any `neomjs/pages` deploy ships a `neomjs/neo` build containing this PR (`#20102`), alongside [`neomjs/pages#54`](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/54). Pre-`#40` `BuildService#fetchDynamicRoutes` matched only `<url>` blocks, so feeding it a `<sitemapindex>` root would silently log `"Resolved 0 valid routes"` and `"All routes are up-to-date. Nothing to build."` without throwing an error.
- Next `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs --corpus-root ...` run emits `sitemap.xml` (index), `sitemap-core.xml`, `sitemap-archive.xml`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `llms-all.txt` into `apps/portal/`, and `npm run build-all` copies all 7 files to `dist/production/apps/portal/`.
